title: The Shepherd's Psalm
verse: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

clues.t: A sacred song of David
He restoreth it
Of righteousness, for his name's sake
Of the shadow of death
Instrument David played for Saul

title: Noah and the Flood
verse: And the rain fell upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.

clues.t: The waters that covered the whole earth
Number of days and nights it rained
Mountains where the vessel came to rest
It fell for forty days and forty nights
Builder found righteous in his generation

title: Born in Bethlehem
verse: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!

clues.t: Found wrapped in swaddling clothes
It went before the wise men to the young child
She kept all these things in her heart
Where the newborn Savior was laid
A wise man's gift, with frankincense and myrrh

title: The Good Shepherd
verse: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.

clues.t: The door of the sheep — enter by it
Behold the ___ of God
It comforts, with the rod
Green place where the shepherd makes us lie
Other sheep I have, which are not of this

title: In the Garden
verse: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, where He placed the man He had formed.

clues.t: Of life, or of knowledge of good and evil
What man was formed from, and returns to
What the woman took and did eat
The most subtil beast of the field
What God took from Adam to make woman
The garden planted eastward
The mother of all living

title: Swallowed by the Sea
verse: Now the LORD had appointed a great fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah spent three days and three nights in the belly of the fish.

clues.t: The mighty tempest sent upon the sea
Days and nights spent inside the fish
A great one, prepared by the LORD
It was like to be broken in the tempest
The great city that repented in sackcloth

title: He Is Risen
verse: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.

clues.t: He is not here, for he is ___
Rolled away by an angel
He asked to be remembered in the kingdom
The crown platted by the soldiers
Rent in twain from top to bottom

title: In the Lions' Den
verse: My God sent His angel and shut the mouths of the lions. They have not hurt me, for I was found innocent in His sight, and I have done no wrong against you, O king.

clues.t: Where the faithful man spent the night
Nebuchadnezzar's forgotten vision
He kneeled three times a day, windows open
Kingdom of the captivity
Sent to protect the man in the pit

title: Ask, Seek, Knock
verse: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.

clues.t: Do it, and you will find
Daniel did this three times a day
Enter his courts with it
So be it — the word that seals a prayer
Do it, and it shall be opened

title: Lunch for a Crowd
verse: Then Jesus took the loaves and the fish, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted.

clues.t: Number of loaves in the boy’s lunch
Green ground cover where the crowd sat
Food shared along with the bread
Containers filled with leftover pieces
Number of fish in the boy’s lunch
Young person who had the loaves and fish

title: Water at the Wedding
verse: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever He tells you.”

clues.t: Liquid the servants poured into the jars
Region where Cana was located
Town where Jesus attended a wedding
Marriage celebration Jesus attended in Cana
Drink that ran out at the wedding

title: Fishers of Men
verse: From now on you will catch men.

clues.t: Son of Zebedee, one of Simon's partners
"Do not be ___," Jesus said to Simon
"Put out into ___ water"
"From now on you will catch ___"
Both boats began to do this

title: The Lost Sheep
verse: What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?

clues.t: Where the flock is kept
What it was when he laid it on his shoulders
There is more of it in heaven over one that repenteth
What the shepherd goes to do
With 'and nine', those left in the wilderness
